text:
Aisha (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — we have a joint marketplace listing with Orbital HW and their SI next Friday. Need clarity on what security artifacts we can publish for the listing page vs what must stay in the private evidence bundle. @Tom @Ben any constraints?
Tom (Security): We can surface a one-paragraph SOC2 summary and a redacted pen-test high-level summary on the public listing. Anything with IP or customer-identifying info must stay in the presigned evidence bundle. Also: no raw vuln scan outputs. :no_entry_sign:
Ben (Marketplace): Agreed. Marketplace compliance wants a short attestation + timestamped artifacts. They typically accept: SOC2 cover letter, pen-test executive summary (redacted), and a signed attestation PDF. We should confirm file formats and TTL for presigns.
Ravi (HW SI): From Orbital side — they can provide SOC2 letter and a pen-test exec summary. They asked whether we need firmware-level logs redacted or omitted.
Tom (Security): Firmware logs = sensitive. Omit or redact specifics (serials, customer IDs, cryptographic material). Provide a sanitized excerpt if they want to demonstrate patching cadence.
Aisha (Partnerships): Lina, legal — anything we need to add for the attestation wording? Orbital wants a template.
Lina (Legal): Keep attestation limited to scope and date. No admissions of liability. Use our standard marketplace attestation template. I’ll paste the template link in a sec.
Ben (Marketplace): On presigns: marketplace expects artefacts available via presigned S3 links with 7–14 day window for review, and we upload final artefacts to the listing bucket with longer retention. evidence-bot can presign. @evidence-bot could you preflight a 14-day presign flow?
evidence-bot: preflight: OK. Default TTL 14 days. Upload path: `s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/orbital-2026-03/`. Presign command: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/orbital-2026-03/<filename> --expires-in 1209600`.
Aisha (Partnerships): Thanks — that's helpful. Two more questions: 1) Can we publish a blanked SOC2 PDF (redacted org-specific sections) on the listing? 2) Who is the upload owner?
Tom (Security): 1) Yes if redaction removes org-specific IDs and scope lines referencing third parties; include a short redaction note. 2) Upload owner should be Partnerships (Aisha) or Ben for marketplace side, but evidence must be cross-signed by Orbital. Recommend: Orbital uploads to their folder, Partnerships verifies, Marketplace finalizes.
Ravi (HW SI): Orbital will upload the initial bundle to the presign path by Tue EOD. We need a checklist of required filenames.
Ben (Marketplace): Checklist (short):
```
- soc2-summary.pdf (redacted, <2 pages)
- pen-test-exec-summary.pdf (redacted)
- attestation-signed.pdf
- evidence-index.txt (names + short descriptions)
```
Aisha (Partnerships): Perfect. I'll assign owners and deadlines: Orbital to upload by Tue EOD; Lina to review attestation language by Wed noon; Tom to do redaction check Wed afternoon; Ben to generate presigns Thu morning; Partnerships to confirm listing copy Thu afternoon.
Lina (Legal): I'll use the marketplace attestation template and send a comment thread.
Tom (Security): For redaction checklist, follow these must-haves: remove serials, IP addresses, customer names/emails, stack traces with secrets, and private PKI material. If uncertain, redact to the paragraph-level.
Ravi (HW SI): Noted. We'll scrub firmware logs and provide sanitized sample.
Ben (Marketplace): Also — marketplace requires an internal contact for escalation during review. Aisha, can you be the primary?
Aisha (Partnerships): I can. Secondary contact: Ravi.
Aisha (Partnerships): Actions recap: Orbital upload Tue EOD (Ravi lead), Lina legal attestation Wed noon, Tom redaction check Wed PM, Ben presigns Thu AM, Partnerships confirm listing Thu PM. If anything slips, call out asap. :thumbsup:
Tom (Security): I'll do a quick QA pass after redaction. :eyes:
Ravi (HW SI): We will coordinate CI job to strip sensitive fields before upload.
Ben (Marketplace): I'll post final presign links and marketplace checklist here when ready.
Aisha (Partnerships): Thanks team. If we get sign-off early we can still make the Friday announcement.
Ben (Marketplace): :rocket:
Lina (Legal): Sending template now -> https://redwood.internal/legal/templates/marketplace_attestation_v2.pdf
Aisha (Partnerships): Great — moving to the action items. I'll ping again tomorrow with status.
